resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Operations Executive, Nilgiri Crest Hospital (fictional, 250 beds), Pune (2023 - present)
- Coordinated IP admissions and discharges with ward nurses and reduced average discharge time by 40 minutes.
- Prepare the morning bed status report and allot beds to emergency and planned admissions.
- Work with nursing, billing, pharmacy and housekeeping teams to clear beds before noon.
- Prepare a daily MIS report on admissions, discharges and occupancy for the GM Operations.
- Resolved patient and attendant complaints at the floor help desk within the same shift.

Front Office Executive, Nilgiri Crest Hospital (fictional), Pune (2021 - 2023)
- Managed OPD registration and doctor appointment scheduling for 12 consultants.
- Entered registrations, admissions and transfers in the hospital information system.

EDUCATION
BBA (Hospital Administration), Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2021

SKILLS
NABH standards, MS Excel, MS Word
